# VC-HB-3110

Manufacturer: HIWIN.
Type code: HGH20CAZ0H.
Block for the HGR20 rail. Preload Z0. Accuracy H.

URL: https://www.hiwin.de/en/configurator/newConfiguration/3PQ_GW
File: `HGH20CAZ0H.stp` (642133 bytes).
The file starts with `ISO-10303-21`.
Downloaded: 2026-11-19.
Terms: HIWIN CAD configurator, free account.
Check the manufacturer's terms before redistributing this file.

The file uses the same mounting plane as the rail. Z = 0 is that plane.
The solid runs from Z = 4.6 mm to Z = 30 mm.
The top of the block is 30 mm from the rail mounting face.
The width is 44 mm and is centred on the rail.
The overall length is 90.4 mm, including the end seals.
Mounting holes are 36 mm apart along the rail and ±16 mm across it.
That hole centre is 5.3 mm from the solid centre.
The assembly centres the solid, so both ends stay on the rail.
`load_vendor_shape` uses `recenter=False`.
The same rotation as the rail maps the mounting plane to X = 0.
The channel clears the rail. The shared volume is 0.
